scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @my-team/web" "npm run start:dev -w @my-team/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @my-team/web && npm run build -w @my-team/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @my-team/web && npm run typecheck -w @my-team/api
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build
